versions.content: If SdClientServiceMinorVersion is set to any value except 0x FFFFFF and SdVersionDrivenFindBehavior is set to EXACT_OR_ANY_MINOR_VER- SION, the Minor Version in a received OfferService or StopOfferService shall be checked for identifying Service Instances and its associated Eventgroups. The Ser- vice Discovery module shall process a OfferService or StopOfferService where the minor version of the received entry match exact the configured minor version of the corresponding SdClientService.
